external_noise.generation_rule: For each tick: numpy.default_rng(seed).random(166700) < 0.024; select Candidate-B node indices. Reinitialize RNG with identical seed at reset of each mirrored run.
external_noise.outcome_selection: NONE; seed is frozen from task calendar date 2026-09-23 before any closed-loop execution.

initial_neural_state.CandidateBInteger.reset: all state zero; prev_fired empty; counters zero

causal_contract: At tick k, snapshot BodyState[k] and static WorldState[k].
Encode FeedbackFrame[k] -> SourceDrive[k+1]; do not apply it during tick k.
Apply already queued SourceDrive[k] to Candidate-B source states.
Generate common deterministic external-noise mask eta[k] and execute CandidateBInteger.step(k).
Extract frozen 32 DN outputs as DNFrame[k].
reset_semantics: LEFT and RIGHT are independent fresh runs: new CandidateBInteger, BodyRuntime, BodyState.zero, preprocessor reset, SourceDrive[0]=neutral, and RNG reinitialized to the same common seed.
trace_requirement: Record per tick B[k],W[k],FeedbackFrame[k],SourceDrive[k],SourceDrive[k+1],DNFrame[k],preprocessor values,MotorDrive[k],B[k+1],noise mask SHA256.

acceptance_logic.PIPELINE_CAUSALITY_PASS: For every tick source_drive_applied[k] equals encoder output stored at tick k-1 (or neutral at k=0); source_drive_next[k] is not applied until k+1; trace lineage hashes and frame IDs consistent.
acceptance_logic.NEURAL_EXECUTION_PASS: All frozen hashes match; authoritative CandidateBInteger executes all 300 ticks per run with no replacement/approximation.
acceptance_logic.DN_INTERFACE_PASS: Exactly 32 DN slots each tick in frozen order, extracted only from Candidate-B fired local indices.
acceptance_logic.MAPPING_EQUIVALENCE_PASS: For every tick independently recompute frozen preprocessing and final mapping formula; exact/1e-15 numerical agreement; non-yaw channels exact zero.
acceptance_logic.BODY_RUNTIME_PASS: BodyState.valid true and all position/orientation/velocity/angular-velocity values finite at all ticks.
acceptance_logic.VISUAL_GEOMETRY_FEEDBACK_PASS: At least one transition has changed body orientation AND changed next azimuth; next azimuth independently recomputes from B[k+1]+same W within absolute tolerance 1e-12.
acceptance_logic.YAW_RESPONSE_PRESENT_PER_RUN: At least one nonzero yaw_rate_ref and at least one nonzero actual body yaw rate during the 300-tick run; no amplitude threshold.
acceptance_logic.MIRRORED_OPPOSITE_YAW_PASS: Signed integral of yaw_rate_ref over 300 ticks is nonzero and opposite between LEFT/RIGHT AND signed integral of actual body yaw rate is nonzero and opposite between LEFT/RIGHT.
acceptance_logic.BODY_ORIENTATION_CHANGED: At least one BodyState orientation differs from identity in each run.

demo0_preservation: MODE_REPLAY remains DEMO-0; DEMO-0 acceptance must be rerun after integration.
